pick.name: unDraw
pick.why: Large SaaS-style set, free commercial use without credit, recolour to brand in one click.
pick.free_limits: Free commercial use, no credit. Forbidden: packs/redistribution, competing service, hotlinking/embedding/scraping without consent, any AI/ML use without written permission

alts.name: Open Peeps / Humaaans
alts.why: CC0: zero restrictions; best for people-centric scenes.

alts.name: Gemini Nano Banana (custom illustrations)
alts.what: Generate on-brand illustrations from a style prompt
alts.why: Unique art in your style; visible watermark on non-Ultra Gemini app images.
alts.free_limits: AI Pro expanded image limits (shared meter)

candidates.name: Blush
candidates.verdict: free plan commercial OK, SVG export Pro

decision: unDraw covers most SaaS empty-states and landing sections free. Use CC0 sets for people and Nano Banana when you need a unique brand style.

verify.note: Licence is stricter than listed: no hotlinking/scraping without consent, and the AI clause covers any AI/ML use incl. testing. Fine for download-and-use.
